domain: Late-medieval Venetian/Genoese double-entry mercantile bookkeeping and reconciliation (Pacioli-codified account discipline, trial balance, suspense accounts, book-closing)
axioms: Every transaction is posted twice and to exactly one pair of accounts: a capability must have exactly one owning account; posting it to two ledgers (duplication) or to none (a floating value) is the cardinal error.

Overlapping ventures require a consolidation decision before the books open: two related accounts are either merged into one, kept separate with an explicit inter-account transfer, or unrelated — deciding wrong compounds through every later entry.

A suspense account is legitimate only with a written clearing condition: a value whose home is unknown may be parked, but it is a debt against clarity that must be cleared, not left to become permanent.

The trial balance proves state without declaring profit: an instrument reports whatever the ledger actually holds, including zero, and must never present a conclusion (a threshold, a tuned number) whose producing transactions have not been posted.
The books are never closed while any account stands unreconciled: no dividend is distributed and no year is declared done while an obligation floats open.
Boundary discipline is the master virtue: each venture, partner, and warehouse gets its own account, and duplicate recording of one warehouse in two ledgers must be reconciled as a precondition.
primitives: account (single owner of a capability: Rimsky, interlock, native worktrees, bd redirect, lbkd, Mycroft)
posting (assigning a capability/transaction to its owning account)
double-posting (a capability duplicated across two accounts — the accidental second fleet orchestrator)
floating value (a capability in no account — lbkd left unassigned)
consolidation decision (subsume / separate-ledger-with-transfer / unrelated for lbkd and Mycroft)
inter-account transfer (a declared dependency edge between ledgers)
trial balance (the conflict-economics telemetry as an honest state instrument, not asserted thresholds)
suspense account (the deferred controller / anti-abandonment obligation with a written clearing condition)
book-closing gate (the internal gate that forbids marking the epic done while an account is unreconciled)
failure_mode: Blind to resource scarcity and throughput dynamics: it will not price the token multiplier, the priming cost of the pre-spawn check, or the worktree crossover — it only asks which account a thing is posted to, not whether the reservoir can afford it.
May treat a genuinely economic runtime trade-off (Q3 crossover, Q5 check cost) as a mere posting question and miss that the real answer is a break-even, not a boundary.
Over-indexes on clean boundaries; can flag an overlap as double-posting when a small deliberate redundancy is actually cheaper than the coordination to eliminate it.
Assumes correctness lives in reconciliation and can undervalue emergent/dynamic failure modes (conflict cascades, rate exhaustion) that no static ledger discipline would catch.
